name: transcription factor 4
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TCF4 encodes transcription factor 4. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Pitt-Hopkins syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
